name: Chombueng Marathon (40th ed.)
short_description: The 40th Chombueng Marathon is a full and half marathon event held on January 31, 2027, at Ratchaburi Rajabhat University in Chom Bueng, Thailand.
ai_summary: The Chombueng Marathon (40th edition) is a full marathon event scheduled for January 31, 2027, in Chom Bueng, Ratchaburi, Thailand. Registration details have not yet been announced.
